WatchPaper · Study Nº 1

The dial, and nothing else.

Ten famous watch dials reduced to pure texture and colour — drawn as vector art, scaled about eight-fold for macro effect, and sized for your lock screen. No logos, no indices, no hands. Tap a dial to try it under a lock-screen clock; download at your phone's exact resolution.

On the naming. Every wallpaper here is an original artwork inspired by a dial finish — waffle guilloché, embossed bars, sunray brushing, lacquer, silvered snow relief, matte grain. Watch model names appear solely to identify which watch a wallpaper pairs with; this study is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any watchmaker.
